name: Newegg search, Intel Arc B580, including Newegg Refreshed refurbished tier
notes: Live Newegg search read 2026-10-03, 'INTEL ARC B580' query, GPUs/Video Graphics Cards department, 60 items/page. Carries Newegg's first-party refurb tier, labelled 'Newegg Refreshed'. New-side: ASRock Challenger B580 12GB $329.99 (was $355.15), Intel Arc B580 Limited Edition $590.00. Refreshed side (all shown OUT OF STOCK at time of capture): Acer Nitro B580 $249.99, ASRock Challenger B580 $259.99, ONIX ODYSSEY B580 $199.99, Intel Arc B580 Limited Edition $199.99. This is the cleanest refurb-vs-new spread observed in this slice: refreshed B580 sits ~27-34% below the new ASRock Challenger price. Caveat: every refreshed unit was out of stock, which is the normal state of this tier.
